[M] Generation Evaluation Workbench
|-- Workbench interface: EvalsPage
|   |-- Exposes prompt editing, run launch, output inspection, experiments and judgements
|   |-- References + layout templates supply reusable generation inputs
|   |-- Selected outputs -> comparison launcher -> comparison or judgement view
|   `-- [O] Local navigation, selections, unsaved edits and polling timers
|       |-- Active jobs trigger faster polling; completed outputs refresh the catalog view
|       `-- Unmount clears timers; late responses cannot update closed views
|
|-- [M] Versioned inputs: EvalPromptService + context and canvas boundaries
|   |-- Public: save, fork, resolve, archive and snapshot prompts
|   |   |-- Content changes append versions; expected base version prevents stale writes
|   |   |-- Forks and edited attempts retain parent version and content hash
|   |   `-- Internal: serialized writes, workflow/template validation and lineage cycle checks
|   |-- [C] resolve(promptId, version, workflow)
|   |   `-- Return stage text, template base, lineage and frozen cited reference text
|   |-- [D] Pinned run inputs [shared INPUTS]
|   |   |-- Prompt versions + stage text + cited and selected reference content
|   |   |-- AgentContext ID + content hash -> resolve sources -> verify hash before generation
|   |   |-- Canvas source + checkpoint -> CompareSessionService.capture()
|   |   |   `-- Copy selected endpoint and required diagram revisions; omit undo history
|   |   `-- Workflow-specific additions: earlier alternatives, canvas sets, layout geometry
|   `-- [O] Run retains its captured meaning across later prompt and canvas edits
|       |-- Reruns reuse matching pins and remain under the original root run
|       `-- Outputs belong to the selected AgentContext
|           `-- Canvas-only workflows create a context describing their pinned inputs
|
|-- [M] Run orchestration: EvalRunService
|   |-- Public: start, prepareForReview, launchPrepared, read, rename, cancel and delete
|   |-- Private: preparation, execution chains, validation, persistence and live-job maps
|   |-- Dependencies -> prompt resolver, context library, comparison capture,
|   |                  EvalRunStore, EvalRuntime and project catalog
|   |-- [C] start(request)
|   |   |-- Validate workflow bindings and request identity
|   |   |   `-- Same request ID + same hash -> existing run; different hash -> conflict
|   |   `-- Prepare [shared INPUTS] -> create cells -> persist queued run -> execute
|   |       |-- Ordinary cells = prompt versions x sample passes x workflow stages
|   |       |-- Independent chains use configured concurrency, default 3
|   |       `-- Session-context delivery uses one chain worker per run
|   |-- [C] Workflow dispatch
|   |   |-- Alternatives -> generate -> validate/materialize canvas
|   |   |   `-- Optional layout template and earlier alternatives constrain the input
|   |   |-- Diagram-change proposal -> retain exact proposal tree -> display canvas
|   |   |   `-- Syntax errors remain available to the deterministic judge
|   |   |-- Linked canvases -> context + captured canvas set -> frozen multi-canvas result
|   |   |-- Roll-up -> r2 -> g2 attachment
|   |   |   |-- [D] r2 needs child canvas + minimized/full parent inputs
|   |   |   |-- [D] g2 additionally needs r2 output and parent history
|   |   |   `-- r2 failure -> mark g2 skipped
|   |   `-- Few-shot refinement -> delegated round executor
|   |       `-- One prompt, three alternatives per round, three rounds; progress judgements
|   |-- [C] generateValidated() -> EvalRuntime.generate() -> workflow validator
|   |   |-- Valid output -> materialize and retain result
|   |   |-- Validation failure -> retry with previous output + validation error
|   |   |   `-- At most 3 generation attempts; usage accumulates across responses
|   |   `-- Runtime failure or exhausted validation -> fail cell
|   |-- [M] Runtime adapter: AgentContextEvalRuntime implements EvalRuntime
|   |   |-- No session context -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   |   `-- Session context -> reuse persisted agent-session execution
|   |       |-- [D] Resolved context + composed prompt + supplementary inputs -> response
|   |       |-- Each invocation gets an independent session and audit ID
|   |       |   `-- Identical prefixes share a cache key, not another sample's answer
|   |       |-- Returns output, usage and session/context/cache provenance
|   |       `-- [O] Owns session, timeout, subscription and abort listener
|   |           |-- Cancellation or timeout -> abort session
|   |           `-- Finally -> clear timer, remove listener, unsubscribe and dispose session
|   |-- [O] Output retention [shared OUTPUTS]
|   |   |-- Single canvas -> catalog saves generated representation
|   |   |   `-- Run retains exact checkpoint snapshot; cell records provenance and usage
|   |   |-- Multi-canvas result -> full frozen documents in run; summary in cell
|   |   |-- History-coordinated result -> timeline/step reference into shared checkpoint store
|   |   `-- captureOutputResult() -> pin an external change-session proposal
|   |       |-- Requires matching project/version and an available output cell
|   |       `-- Captures without accepting changes or starting generation; cannot overwrite a pin
|   `-- [O] Run lifecycle
|       |-- Serialized snapshot saves preserve update order; live state preserves renames
|       |-- Cells: queued -> generating -> finished / failed / cancelled; dependents may skip
|       |   `-- Run status derives from cells; mixed success becomes partial
|       |-- Restart -> fail unfinished local cells and retain completed outputs
|       |   `-- Diagram-history runs delegate recovery to their durable external coordinator
|       `-- Delete -> abort work, drain pending saves, archive outputs and tombstone run
|           |-- Deleting a root run also deletes its reruns; explicit batch deletion is selective
|           `-- Deleted-run guard prevents later progress saves from resurrecting it
|
|-- [M] Experiment organization: ExperimentService
|   |-- Public: save, read, approve, relaunch and judge
|   |-- Design: phases + conditions + input cases + numbered samples and attempts
|   |   `-- Stage outputs reference run ID + cell key [shared OUTPUTS]
|   |-- Internal: prepared runs, request receipts and started-run IDs stay out of public records
|   |-- [D] Valid design needs matching project, context/hash, cells and judgement subjects
|   |   `-- Comparison subjects must belong to its phase, cases and conditions
|   |-- [C] save planned generation -> EvalRunService.prepareForReview()
|   |   `-- Freeze prompts and inputs -> persist awaiting-approval review
|   |       `-- approve(expectedRevision) -> persist receipt -> launchPrepared() per run
|   |           |-- Record started IDs so repeated approval can resume remaining launches
|   |           `-- Approved plans and input assignments remain fixed; additions use new phases
|   |-- [C] relaunch selected stage with edited prompt
|   |   `-- Validate edits -> fork immutable prompt -> launch rerun -> append next attempt
|   `-- [C] judge selected comparison
|       `-- Finished proposal trees [shared OUTPUTS] -> deterministic tree evaluator
|           `-- Save typed judgement -> attach judgement ID to experiment comparison
|
|-- [M] Comparison and assessment
|   |-- CompareSessionService exposes candidates, capture, create and createPinned
|   |   |-- Dependencies -> saved workspace records, generated canvas source and session repository
|   |   |-- [C] create(pairs) -> capture sources -> createPinned() -> store comparison session
|   |   |   `-- Request ID + content hash make repeated creation idempotent
|   |   |-- [D] Each pane needs its captured checkpoint and rendering revisions
|   |   |   |-- Whole-canvas pane -> stored viewport and optional focus targets
|   |   |   `-- Diagram pane -> matching revision plus validated slice/subtree selection
|   |   `-- [O] Session owns independent copies; later source edits do not alter comparison
|   |       `-- Repeated references to the same source share one captured copy within the session
|   `-- JudgementService exposes list, read, delete and typed result saves
|       |-- [C] Reconcile comparison sessions/jobs -> durable typed judgement records
|       |   |-- Canvas comparison, diagram comparison and comparison report
|       |   `-- Native saves also retain few-shot progress and deterministic change-tree results
|       |-- [D] Assessment = subject references + captured evidence + evaluator metadata + result
|       |   `-- Subject references connect back to run/cell provenance [shared OUTPUTS]
|       `-- [O] Judgement owns its attachments and may evaluate several runs
|           |-- Serialized reconciliation preserves deletion tombstones
|           `-- Deleting an active imported judgement also deletes its comparison job
|
`-- [M] Publication boundary: completed evaluation output -> project catalog
    |-- Public: promotionTargets, promotionSource and promoteOutput
    |-- [D] Promotion needs a finished cell [shared OUTPUTS] + destination + request signature
    |   `-- Resolve source from history artifact, frozen result or exact canvas checkpoint
    |-- [C] promoteOutput()
    |   |-- Existing matching receipt -> return receipt; signature mismatch -> conflict
    |   |-- Existing-canvas destination -> check settled target and expected revision
    |   |   `-- Reject if its workspace copy has unsaved edits
    |   `-- prepareOutputPromotion() -> projectCatalogs.publishOutputPromotion()
    |       `-- Supply documents, optional new canvas project and run/cell placement provenance
    `-- [O] Catalog owns publication and its receipt
        `-- Placement-lineage backfill requires the original matching promotion receipt
